before.name: Burn Ward
before.effect: Attacking a target with burn triggers accumulated burn damage. Burn inflicted -5% of base damage.

after.name: Burn Phobia
after.effect: Cannot trigger accumulated burn damage with attacks. Burn inflicted -5% of base damage.
after.notes: 2026-10-03: renamed from "Burn Ward" (Ward→Phobia, decided 2026-09-29). Effect fixed: first sentence was copied un-inverted from Burn Specialist (granted the perk's burn-trigger benefit); now mirrors it as a penalty.

before.name: Lifeless
before.effect: Cannot heal from direct damage dealt.

after.name: Lifeless
after.effect: Recoil: after dealing direct damage, this unit takes self-damage equal to 4% of the direct damage dealt (half of Lifesteal's 8%). Non-lethal: recoil can never reduce HP below 1.
after.notes: 2026-10-03: half-recoil rewrite (decided 2026-09-29). Replaces old "Cannot heal from direct damage dealt." Recoil = 50% of paired Lifesteal value (8% → 4%). Never kills: floors at 1 HP.

before.name: Lifeless (Greater)
before.effect: Cannot heal from direct damage dealt.

after.name: Lifeless (Greater)
after.effect: Recoil: after dealing direct damage, this unit takes self-damage equal to 4.8% of the direct damage dealt (half of Greater Lifesteal's 9.6%). Non-lethal: recoil can never reduce HP below 1.
after.notes: 2026-10-03: half-recoil rewrite (decided 2026-09-29). Replaces old "Cannot heal from direct damage dealt." Recoil = 50% of paired Greater Lifesteal value (9.6% → 4.8%). Never kills: floors at 1 HP.
